decision.title: Clambake
tracklist: How Can You Lose What You Never Had

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (12 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clambake_(soundtrack), https://www.shugarecords.com/products/elvispresleyclambake1967-newlprecord2010musiconvinyleuropeimport180gramvinyl-soundtrackrockroll. Original LP RCA Victor LPM/LSP 3893 (Oct 1967), 12 tracks. Only 7 are film songs; 5 are bonus tracks recorded Sept 1967 outside the film sessions: 'Guitar Man', 'You Don't Know Me', 'How Can You Lose What You Never Had', 'Big Boss Man', 'Singing Tree', 'Just Call Me Lonesome'.
